images.filename: Giraffes at Nsele Park in Kinshasa, DR Congo.jpg
images.caption: A group of zebras at Parc de la Vallée de la Nsele, the largest city park in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. As you stroll through the park's well-maintained pathways, you may catch a glimpse of these elegant giants gracefully grazing on the foliage, their gentle movements captivating the attention of onlookers.
images.alt: A group of zebras at Parc de la Vallée de la Nsele, the largest city park in Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo. As you stroll through the park's well-maintained pathways, you may catch a glimpse of these elegant giants gracefully grazing on the foliage, their gentle movements captivating the attention of onlookers.

images.filename: Nsele Valley Park, Kinshasa, DR Congo.jpg
images.caption: I visited the Parc de la Vallée de la Nsele in October 2021 and took a lot of pictures. As you stroll through the park's well-maintained pathways, you may catch a glimpse of these elegant giants gracefully grazing on the foliage, their gentle movements captivating the attention of onlookers. The park's commitment to conservation and wildlife preservation ensures that the buffaloes have a natural and protected habitat to call their own.
images.alt: I visited the Parc de la Vallée de la Nsele in October 2021 and took a lot of pictures. As you stroll through the park's well-maintained pathways, you may catch a glimpse of these elegant giants gracefully grazing on the foliage, their gentle movements captivating the attention of onlookers. The park's commitment to conservation and wildlife preservation ensures that the buffaloes have a natural and protected habitat to call their own.

images.filename: A view of Congo River from Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).jpg
images.caption: The Congo River is the second-longest river in Africa, and its beauty is truly awe-inspiring. The view of the river from Kinshasa, the capital city of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, is particularly stunning. The river winds its way through the lush green landscape, surrounded by towering trees and vibrant wildlife.
